gloss: to dress (food), to mix with dressing

definitions.gloss: to dress, to mix with seasoning/dressing
definitions.explanation: To mix vegetables or other foods with a dressing or sauce.

examples.japanese: ほうれん{草|そう}をごまで{和|あ}える。
{野菜|やさい}を{味噌|みそ}で{和|あ}える。
{酢味噌|すみそ}で{和|あ}えた{刺身|さしみ}。

notes:
{和|あ}える is a cooking term meaning to dress or mix vegetables with a seasoned sauce.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: Xを Yで{和|あ}える (to dress X with Y)

COMMON DRESSINGS ({和|あ}え{衣|ごろも}):
- ごま{和|あ}え: sesame dressing
- {酢味噌|すみそ}{和|あ}え: vinegar-miso dressing
- {白和|しらあ}え: mashed tofu dressing
- {梅肉|ばいにく}{和|あ}え: plum paste dressing
- からし{和|あ}え: mustard dressing
- {酢|す}の{物|もの}: vinegared dish

COMMON INGREDIENTS TO DRESS:
- ほうれん{草|そう}: spinach
- {小松菜|こまつな}: komatsuna greens
- いんげん: green beans
- こんにゃく: konjac

NOTE:
Distinct from Western-style "dressing" (ドレッシング). {和|あ}える refers specifically to Japanese-style dressed dishes.
